fact: Al-Watwan reports Comoros has a national data governance strategy, validated at a 24-25 August 2026 Moroni workshop, whose first axis is data sovereignty, with the State seeking to control the production, storage, circulation, use and protection of administration data.
system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance des données

fact: Al-Watwan reports the recent opening of the first data centre of the public administration, which minister Oumouri Mmadi Hassani calls an important advance for digital sovereignty.
system: premier data center de l'administration publique

fact: The Data Center of the Public Administration, co-managed by state agency ANADEN and Comores Câbles, hosts critical services that allowed the national .km domain's technical management to be transferred to ANADEN; the page also says it is meant to host public platforms and secure administrative data.
system: Data Center of the Public Administration
